title: The Chandrakant Jha Serial Murders
evidence: Victims' bodies and body parts were recovered from different locations
Police investigation connected Jha to multiple disappearances
Jha's relationships with victims helped establish the pattern of offending
Physical and circumstantial evidence linked him to multiple murders
He was convicted of multiple murders
modus_operandi: Jha befriended young male migrant workers and developed relationships with them before murdering and dismembering them. He subsequently attempted to conceal or manipulate the discovery of their remains.
personality_disorder: No confirmed clinical personality-disorder diagnosis should be assigned from the publicly available evidence. His documented behavioral profile demonstrates manipulation, interpersonal exploitation, deception, and extreme violence.
summary: Delhi serial killer who befriended young male migrant workers before murdering and dismembering them. Jha was convicted of multiple murders and received death sentences that were subsequently commuted to life imprisonment.
